label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: SciFi tracker, Upgrade I: three stations of four layers of modules

quantities.name: modules
quantities.definition: SciFi modules in the expanded IR (12 layers)
quantities.derivation: 4 layers x (10 + 10 + 12) modules in T1, T2, T3 (detector-atlas:C157; C158: six per side in T3, one less per side in T1 and T2); independently 4096 SiPM arrays (C159) / (16 arrays at each of a module's two readout ends, C159, C160) = 128

independence.result: a design count derived from two independent statements of the collaboration's detector paper (module layout and SiPM count), which agree; not a simulation output

negative_control.change: one module fewer in each X layer of T1 and T2 (9 instead of 10)

quantities.name: cfrp_x0
quantities.definition: x/X0 of the two CFRP skins of one module at normal incidence (a geantino through the last X layer of T3, inside a fibre mat)
quantities.derivation: LHCb table 7: 2 x 200 um / 27.6 cm = 0.145% X0 (detector-atlas:C163), an estimate from the thickness and the PDG 2020 radiation length

independence.result: independent of Geant4: table 7 is LHCb's estimate from component thicknesses and PDG radiation lengths, not a simulation (the 13.7% X0 of figure 46 is simulated and is not used). Geant4 computes the radiation length of the modelled carbon with the Tsai formula; agreement validates the skins' thickness, density and the carbon-only material within the stated approximation, not radiation-length physics. Tolerance 2%: the printed 0.145% (+-0.34%) and 27.6 cm (+-0.18%), and the carbon-only composition, whose difference from LHCb's 42.5 g/cm2 (27.6 cm x 1.54 g/cm3) is not sourced here and is taken as at most 1.5%.

negative_control.change: CFRP skins 0.18 mm instead of 0.2 mm

approximations: each module is the stack of table 7's components (C163) over the full module outline, 4 x 130.6 mm + 3 x 0.35 mm wide and 2 x 2424 mm + 2 mm high (C161, C162): CFRP 0.2, honeycomb 19.7, glue 0.26, polyimide 2 x 0.025, the fibre-mat layer (eight mats of 1.35 mm on a 4 x 2 grid), polyimide 2 x 0.025, glue, honeycomb, CFRP; the order of glue and polyimide within the stack is not sourced

materials have table 7's densities, with compositions that are not sourced: CFRP as carbon only, polyaramid as C14H10N2O2, the glue as a bisphenol-A epoxy, the polyimide as C22H10N2O5, the fibre mat as polystyrene (the TiO2-loaded epoxy is not modelled); only the CFRP enters a quantity
sidewalls (+0.145% X0), mirror end-pieces (+1.15% X0), SiPMs, readout boxes and C-Frames are not modelled

modules are placed at the cited pitches (531 mm X, 532 mm stereo) and the stereo layers rotated by +-5 degrees about z as a whole; the z positions of the layers (100 mm apart) and stations (1.5 m apart) are not sourced
the per-module total of 1.03% X0 (table 7) needs a path scorer summing several materials, which the S7 path_x0 measure does not provide; it is not a quantity of this case
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
